_about: Small Saudi-dialect glossary used by the dialect-normalisation tool. Keys are written in NORMALISED form (أ/إ/آ->ا, ة->ه, ى->ي). Extend freely; no code change needed.

terms.يعلق: freezes / hangs (MSA: يتجمد / يتوقف عن الاستجابة)
terms.يقفل: closes by itself / crashes (MSA: يُغلق فجأة)
terms.يطلعني: kicks me out of the app (MSA: يُخرجني)
terms.مره: very (dialect intensifier) or 'one time' depending on context
terms.عشان: because / in order to (MSA: لأن / من أجل)
terms.علشان: because / in order to (MSA: لأن / من أجل)
